description: The University of Zagreb describes a georeferenced inventory of painted markings on roads DC1, DC3 and DC29. It contains 63 sheets organized by marking codes, with one row per marked segment. Described fields include chainage, coordinates, length, area, line pattern, colour, width, material, quantity and creation or modification dates. This defines physical road assets and marking treatments for road-safety and infrastructure representation. No files are exposed in native metadata because access is restricted. The sheet count is source-reported, while observation values, completeness of each route and the actual workbook format remain unverified. The named source creators provide this metadata through Zenodo, whose deposits declare CC BY 4.0. Access restrictions and underlying provider terms remain separate from that declaration; cost is unknown unless explicitly stated. Geographic and temporal coverage are limited to the source-described roads, scenarios or periods. Metadata only was reviewed, with no files, measurements, imagery, archives or document bodies downloaded. Related components retain their distinct native identities and possible overlap. The described physical assets, observations or simulator outputs support road infrastructure simulation within these stated limits.
